notes.value: Alektra MINI X2, the two-door Alektra microcar, sold with a choice of three batteries. Per PakNEV: Base 7.2 kWh, 100 km CLTC (about 70 km real-world), 30 Nm, AC 1.5 kW, 450 kg, 100 L boot, PKR 1,095,000; Standard 10.8 kWh, 140 km (about 98 km), 40 Nm, AC 2 kW, 520 kg, 120 L boot, PKR 1,145,000; Long Range 12.96 kWh, 180 km (about 126 km), 50 Nm, AC 2.2 kW, 580 kg, 120 L boot, PKR 1,195,000. The figures shown above are the Base's, with the range and price spanning all three. Rear-wheel drive, top speed 45 km/h (Base) or 50 km/h, PakNEV gives the Base 2.68 hp against 7 hp for the other two, so no power figure is shown. Charges from a 220V home socket; there is no DC fast charging. 2,450 x 1,250 x 1,650 mm on a 1,700 mm wheelbase, 120 mm ground clearance, 2 seats plus a small fold-down rear bench. Warranty 2 years on the battery and 2 years on the motor. Locally assembled; showroom at Liberty Parking Plaza, Lahore. Source: PakNEV.

notes.value: Alektra Solar MINI X4, the four-door Alektra microcar with a roof-mounted solar panel, sold with a choice of three batteries. Per PakNEV: Base 7.2 kWh, 100 km CLTC (about 70 km real-world), 30 Nm, AC 1.5 kW, 450 kg, 100 L boot, PKR 1,345,000; Standard 10.8 kWh, 140 km (about 98 km), 40 Nm, AC 2 kW, 520 kg, 120 L boot, PKR 1,395,000; Long Range 12.96 kWh, 180 km (about 126 km), 50 Nm, AC 2.2 kW, 580 kg, 120 L boot, PKR 1,495,000. The figures shown above are the Base's, with the range and price spanning all three. Rear-wheel drive, top speed 50 km/h, 7 hp, LFP battery. Charges from a 220V home socket; there is no DC fast charging. 2,600 x 1,280 x 1,650 mm on a 1,850 mm wheelbase (PakWheels and Gari.pk four-door variant pages), 120 mm ground clearance, 4 seats. The roof panel trickle-charges the battery; Alektra credits it with up to about 50 km of extra range a day in sunshine, which is not added to the range here. Warranty 2 years on the battery and 2 years on the motor. Locally assembled; showroom at Liberty Parking Plaza, Lahore. Source: PakNEV.
